people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”
translations.bsb: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.”
translations.kjv: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
translations.asv: and she called his name Joseph, saying, Jehovah add to me another son.
